method: Little Cayman and Cayman Brac, all coasts, as one area. The official list is the Cayman Islands Department of Environment public-mooring spreadsheets for each island (January 2023 update, linked from doe.ky/resources/public-moorings): 65 Little Cayman and 68 Cayman Brac named moorings with depth and WGS84 coordinates, counted as one list; a site moored more than once (the Captain Keith Tibbetts' three moorings, Tailor Wall east and west, Great Wall east and west) is one row at its first mooring. Operator site lists, each one list: Reef Divers (the dive-site maps it publishes for Little Cayman Beach Resort and Cayman Brac Beach Resort, one owner, so one list), Southern Cross Club (its Little Cayman dive-site map), Little Cayman Divers (its site highlights; Bloody Bay Scuba School is the same shop) and Brac Scuba Shack (its wall, wreck and dive-site pages). Pirates Point publishes no site names; magazines, review sites and dive-log apps were read for leads only. A site is counted when it is on two lists; Bloody Bay Wall is the stretch of named moorings, not a site of its own. Operator names are matched to moorings by name and map position, and variant spellings stay in the row name (Gillembo, Plymouth Rock, Bluff Wall, Cayman Mariner). Excluded: names on the mooring list or one operator list only, the sites the operator maps mark as snorkel stops and the DoE does not moor, Blacktip Tunnels (inside the 2021 no-diving overlay zone, permit only), and the Brac yacht mooring. Every mooring lies at 87 ft or shallower, and the Tibbetts wreck is sold as a recreational dive. Counted 2026-10-14.
